compute_dcgan_discriminator_loss: compute the DCGAN discriminator loss using softplus on real and fake logits
compute_dcgan_generator_loss: compute the DCGAN generator loss using softplus on fake logits
compute_hinge_discriminator_loss: compute the hinge discriminator loss using ReLU on real and fake logits
compute_hinge_generator_loss: compute the hinge generator loss by negating the mean of fake logits
use_default_generator_loss: use the default generator loss which is set to hinge loss
